purpose: Define route bindings from HTTP/web paths to exact nanoCMS structural nodes or placed MetaModule views without making URLs the canonical identity of content.

topics.name: nanoCMS Route Binding
topics.purpose: Define route bindings from HTTP/web paths to exact nanoCMS structural nodes or placed MetaModule views without making URLs the canonical identity of content.

semantics.route_rule: Route maps an explicit route pattern/path to an exact target identity.
semantics.identity_rule: Changing a route does not change target semantic identity.
semantics.uniqueness_rule: Conflicting active route bindings in the same listener/site scope hard-fail unless explicit routing precedence exists.
semantics.parameter_rule: Route parameters are explicit binding inputs.
semantics.redirect_rule: Redirect/alias semantics are explicit and do not duplicate target identity.
semantics.listener_rule: Route is evaluated within an explicit named web/nanoCMS listener instance.
semantics.authority_rule: Route reachability does not grant AccessCore authorization.

invariants.rule: nanoCMS owns canonical web/site structure, routes, navigation and MetaModule placement/bindings; it never becomes owner of the placed MetaModule's semantics.

hard_gates.condition: route conflict silently resolved by file order

references.purpose: Routes operate within named listener instances.

prose.summary: Define route bindings from HTTP/web paths to exact nanoCMS structural nodes or placed MetaModule views without making URLs the canonical identity of content.
